title: Lye
summary: LYE, noun [Latin lix, whence lixivium; Ant. Latin lixa, whence Lugdunum, Leyden, Lyons, that is Water-town.] Water impregnated with alkaline salt imbibed from the ashes of wood. LYE, noun A falsehod.

inlines.v: LYE, noun [Latin lix, whence lixivium; Ant. Latin lixa, whence Lugdunum, Leyden, Lyons, that is Water-town.] Water impregnated with alkaline salt imbibed from the ashes of wood. LYE, noun A falsehod. [See Lie.]
